name: flagship
vibe: The benchmark — a BRIGHT, luminous product-showcase launch film in the Apple keynote / Linear / Stripe / Vercel / Framer / Raycast register. A white, airy stage with a soft pastel mesh-gradient environment, big floating dashboard panels holding real product screenshots (screenshots are the hero, ~40-60% of frame), lifted off the page by soft real shadows, plus purposeful data-graphics (traveling gradient data-waves + a rising growth graph-line that reinforce the product story) and high-contrast slate typography. Rendered as a native Three.js scene with a cinematic camera that dollies, focus-pulls, orbits and pulls back to guide the eye. No dark backgrounds, no bloom.
